werIndicator = machine.model
		and machine.model:FindFirstChild(Setting.PowerIndicatorName)
		or nil
	if machine.powerIndicator and machine.powerIndicator:IsA("BasePart") then
		machine.powerIndicatorOffColor = machine.powerIndicator.Color
	elseif machine.model then
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing BasePart %s",
			machine.model:GetFullName(),
			Setting.PowerIndicatorName
		))
		machine.powerIndicator = nil
	end
	local hydraulic = machine.model and machine.model:FindFirstChild(Setting.HydraulicName, true) or nil
	machine.ramPart = hydraulic and hydraulic:FindFirstChild(Setting.RamPartName, true) or nil
	machine.startAttachment = machine.submitPart
		and machine.submitPart:FindFirstChild(Setting.OutputStartAttachment)
		or nil
	machine.endAttachment = machine.submitPart
		and machine.submitPart:FindFirstChild(Setting.OutputEndAttachment)
		or nil

	local requirement = machine.requirement
	local validCountMode = requirement
		and (requirement.CountMode == "Entity" or requirement.CountMode == "Param")
	local hasMatcher = requirement
		and (requirement.MatchItemId ~= nil or requirement.MatchItemType ~= nil)
	local validRequirement = type(requirement) == "table"
		and machine.requiredAmount > 0
		and validCountMode
		and hasMatcher

	if not machine.model then
		machine.disabled = true
		warn(string.format("[WeaponWorkshopService] Missing %s", machineDefinition.ModelName))
	elseif not validRequirement then
		machine.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] Disabled %s: invalid requirement config",
			machine.model:GetFullName()
		))
	elseif not machine.submitPart or not machine.submitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		machine.disabled = true
		warn(string.format("[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing 提交框", machine.model:GetFullName()))
	elseif not machine.ramPart or not machine.ramPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		machine.disabled = true
		warn(string.format("[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing hydraulic ram Union", machine.model:GetFullName()))
	elseif not machine.startAttachment or not machine.startAttachment:IsA("Attachment")
		or not machine.endAttachment or not machine.endAttachment:IsA("Attachment")
	then
		machine.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] Disabled %s: 提交框 requires Attachment 1 and 2",
			machine.model:GetFullName()
		))
	elseif not ResourcesItemHelper:FindPrefab(machine.outputId) then
		machine.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] Disabled %s: missing output prefab %d",
			machine.model:GetFullName(),
			machine.outputId
		))
	end

	if machine.ramPart then
		machine.ramStartCFrame = machine.ramPart.CFrame
	end
	if machine.model and validRequirement then
		bindRequirementUI(machine)
	end
	if machine.submitPart then
		machine.submitPart.CanTouch = false
		local touchConnection = machine.submitPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
			local item = getResourceItem(otherPart)
			if item then
				attemptMachineSubmit(machine, item)
			end
		end)
		trackConnection(state, touchConnection)

		local touchEndedConnection = machine.submitPart.TouchEnded:Connect(function(otherPart)
			local item = getResourceItem(otherPart)
			if item and machine.rejectedItems[item] then
				task.defer(function()
					if not isItemOverlappingPart(item, machine.submitPart) then
						machine.rejectedItems[item] = nil
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		trackConnection(state, touchEndedConnection)
	end

	return machine
end

local function bindAssembly(state, workshop)
	local assembly = {
		state = state,
		model = workshop:FindFirstChild(Setting.AssemblyModelName),
		placeholderFolder = nil,
		placeholderCenterPosition = nil,
		submitPart = nil,
		slots = {},
		slotByRequiredId = {},
		token = string.format("%s:assembly", state.token),
		busy = false,
		pendingGun = nil,
		placementCount = 0,
		outputConnections = {},
		disabled = false,
	}
	state.assembly = assembly

	if not assembly.model then
		assembly.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing %s",
			workshop:GetFullName(),
			Setting.AssemblyModelName
		))
		return
	end

	assembly.submitPart = assembly.model:FindFirstChild(Setting.AssemblySubmissionName)
	if not assembly.submitPart or not assembly.submitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		assembly.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing assembly submission part %s",
			assembly.model:GetFullName(),
			Setting.AssemblySubmissionName
		))
		return
	end
	assembly.submitPart.CanTouch = false

	assembly.placeholderFolder = assembly.model:FindFirstChild(Setting.PlaceholderFolderName)
	if not assembly.placeholderFolder or not assembly.placeholderFolder:IsA("Model") then
		assembly.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing placeholder model %s",
			assembly.model:GetFullName(),
			Setting.PlaceholderFolderName
		))
		return
	end
	local placeholderBoundsCFrame = assembly.placeholderFolder:GetBoundingBox()
	assembly.placeholderCenterPosition = placeholderBoundsCFrame.Position

	for _, slotDefinition in ipairs(Setting.AssemblySlots) do
		local slot = {
			placeholder = assembly.placeholderFolder:FindFirstChild(slotDefinition.PlaceholderName),
			placeholderCFrame = nil,
			placeholderTransparency = {},
			requiredId = slotDefinition.RequiredId,
			item = nil,
			placing = false,
			itemWatchConnection = nil,
			rejectedItems = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
		}
		table.insert(assembly.slots, slot)
		assembly.slotByRequiredId[slot.requiredId] = slot

		if slot.placeholder and slot.placeholder:IsA("Model") then
			local placeholderParts = getBaseParts(slot.placeholder)
			if #placeholderParts > 0 then
				slot.placeholderCFrame = slot.placeholder:GetPivot()
				for _, part in ipairs(placeholderParts) do
					slot.placeholderTransparency[part] = part.Transparency
					part.Anchored = true
					part.CanCollide = false
					part.CanTouch = false
					part.CanQuery = false
				end
			end
		end

		if not slot.placeholderCFrame then
			assembly.disabled = true
			warn(string.format(
				"[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing placeholder %s or it has no BaseParts",
				assembly.placeholderFolder:GetFullName(),
				slotDefinition.PlaceholderName
			))
		end
	end

	local touchConnection = assembly.submitPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
		local item = getResourceItem(otherPart)
		local slot = item and assembly.slotByRequiredId[getItemId(item)] or nil
		if slot then
			attemptAssemblySubmit(assembly, slot, item)
		end
	end)
	trackConnection(state, touchConnection)

	local touchEndedConnection = assembly.submitPart.TouchEnded:Connect(function(otherPart)
		local item = getResourceItem(otherPart)
		local slot = item and assembly.slotByRequiredId[getItemId(item)] or nil
		if item and slot and slot.rejectedItems[item] then
			task.defer(function()
				if not isItemOverlappingPart(item, assembly.submitPart) then
					slot.rejectedItems[item] = nil
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	trackConnection(state, touchEndedConnection)

	if not ResourcesItemHelper:FindPrefab(Setting.RifleId) then
		assembly.disabled = true
		warn(string.format(
			"[WeaponWorkshopService] Disabled assembly: missing rifle prefab %d",
			Setting.RifleId
		))
	end
end

local function refreshWorkshop(state, shouldScan)
	for _, machine in ipairs(state.machines) do
		refreshMachine(machine)
	end
	if state.assembly then
		refreshAssembly(state.assembly)
	end

	if shouldScan and state.powered and not state.destroyed then
		task.defer(function()
			for _, machine in ipairs(state.machines) do
				scanMachine(machine)
			end
			if state.assembly then
				scanAssembly(state.assembly)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function cleanupWorkshop(state)
	if state.destroyed then
		return
	end
	state.destroyed = true
	boundWorkshops[state.workshop] = nil

	for tween in pairs(state.tweens) do
		tween:Cancel()
	end
	table.clear(state.tweens)

	for connection in pairs(state.connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(state.connections)

	for _, machine in ipairs(state.machines) do
		if machine.submitPart and machine.submitPart.Parent then
			machine.submitPart.CanTouch = false
		end
		if machine.ramPart and machine.ramPart.Parent and machine.ramStartCFrame then
			machine.ramPart.CFrame = machine.ramStartCFrame
		end
	end

	if state.assembly then
		restoreAssemblyPlaceholders(state.assembly)
		if state.assembly.submitPart and state.assembly.submitPart.Parent then
			state.assembly.submitPart.CanTouch = false
		end
	end

	local lockedItems = {}
	for item in pairs(state.lockedItems) do
		table.insert(lockedItems, item)
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(lockedItems) do
		if item.Parent then
			unlockItem(
				state,
				item,
				true,
				item:GetAttribute(Setting.ReservationAttribute)
			)
		else
			state.lockedItems[item] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function bindWorkshop(workshop)
	if boundWorkshops[workshop]
		or not workshop:IsA("Model")
		or not workshop:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
	then
		return
	end

	local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
	if prefabs and workshop:IsDescendantOf(prefabs) then
		return
	end

	local frame = workshop:FindFirstChild("大框架")
	local switch = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("开关") or nil
	local state = {
		workshop = workshop,
		switch = switch,
		token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		powered = false,
		destroyed = false,
		machines = {},
		assembly = nil,
		lockedItems = {},
		unpoweredTipAtByPlayer = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		connections = {},
		tweens = {},
	}
	boundWorkshops[workshop] = state

	if not frame then
		warn(string.format("[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing 大框架", workshop:GetFullName()))
	end
	if not switch then
		warn(string.format("[WeaponWorkshopService] %s is missing 开关", workshop:GetFullName()))
	end

	for index, machineDefinition in ipairs(Setting.Machines) do
		bindMachine(state, frame, machineDefinition, index)
	end
	bindAssembly(state, workshop)

	if switch then
		local powerConnection = switch:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Setting.PowerAttribute):Connect(function()
			local wasPowered = state.powered
			state.powered = switch:GetAttribute(Setting.PowerAttribute) == true
			if state.powered and not wasPowered then
				playEffect(Setting.PowerOnSoundName, switch)
			end
			refreshWorkshop(state, state.powered and not wasPowered)
		end)
		trackConnection(state, powerConnection)
		state.powered = switch:GetAttribute(Setting.PowerAttribute) == true
	end

	local destroyingConnection = workshop.Destroying:Connect(function()
		cleanupWorkshop(state)
	end)
	trackConnection(state, destroyingConnection)

	refreshWorkshop(state, state.powered)
end

for _, workshop in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(Setting.WorkshopTag)) do
	task.defer(function()
		bindWorkshop(workshop)
	end)
end

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Setting.WorkshopTag):Connect(function(workshop)
	task.defer(function()
		bindWorkshop(workshop)
	end)
end)
"},{"id":353,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameEnum = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local MapHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))
local EnemyHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EnemyHelper"))

local MAX_GROUND_DISTANCE = 175
local SPAWN_CHANCE_DENOMINATOR = 3
local RESPAWN_COOLDOWN = 20 * 60
local SPAWN_HEIGHT_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

local definitions = {
    {
        key = "BigTurkey",
        enabled = GameHelper.Switch.BigTurkey,
        enemyId = 111,
        tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTurkey,
        gridTypes = {
            [MapHelper.GridType.Marsh] = true,
            [MapHelper.GridType.ToxicSwamp] = true,
        },
    },
}

local states = {
    BigTurkey = {
        nextSpawnTime = 0,
        isSpawning = false,
    },
    KingMoose = {
        nextSpawnTime = 0,
        isSpawning = false,
        nest = nil,
    },
}

local function hasLiveBoss(definition)
    return #CollectionService:GetTagged(definition.tag) > 0
end

local function spawnBoss(definition, ground, gridPoint)
    if not definition.enabled then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X, gridPoint.Z)
    if not definition.gridTypes[gridType] then return end

    if definition.minZoneLevel or definition.maxZoneLevel then
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X, gridPoint.Z)
        if type(zoneLevel) ~= "number" then return end
        if definition.minZoneLevel and zoneLevel < definition.minZoneLevel then return end
        if definition.maxZoneLevel and zoneLevel > definition.maxZoneLevel then return end
    end

    if math.random(1, SPAWN_CHANCE_DENOMINATOR) ~= 1 then return end

    local state = states[definition.key]
    if state.isSpawning then return end
    if workspace.DistributedGameTime < state.nextSpawnTime then return end
    if hasLiveBoss(definition) then return end

    local landingPoint = MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(ground.Position)
    if typeof(landingPoint) ~= "Vector3" then return end

    state.isSpawning = true

    local boss:Model? = nil
    local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
        boss = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(definition.enemyId)
        if not boss then
            error(string.format("Missing enemy prefab/config for id %d", definition.enemyId))
        end

        boss:PivotTo(CFrame.new(landingPoint) + SPAWN_HEIGHT_OFFSET)
        boss:AddTag(definition.tag)
        boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss)

        local humanoid = boss:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then
            error(string.format("Enemy %d prefab is missing a Humanoid", definition.enemyId))
        end

        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            state.nextSpawnTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + RESPAWN_COOLDOWN
        end)

        boss.Parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(definition.enemyId)
    end)

    state.isSpawning = false

    if not success then
        if boss then
            boss:Destroy()
        end
        warn(string.format("[AnimalBossSpawnService] Failed to spawn %s: %s", definition.key, tostring(errorMessage)))
    end
end

GameHelper.GroundSpawnEnterC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, ground: Instance)
    local gridPoint = GameHelper:ValidateGroundSpawnRequest(player, ground, MAX_GROUND_DISTANCE)
    if not gridPoint then return end

    for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
        spawnBoss(definition, ground, gridPoint)
    end
end)

local kingMooseState = states.KingMoose

local function getKingMooseSpawnPosition(nest: Model)
    local spawnPoint = nest:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点",true)
    if not spawnPoint or not spawnPoint:IsA("BasePart") then
        warn("[AnimalBossSpawnService] King Moose nest is missing 敌人生成点")
        return
    end

    local landingPoint = MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(spawnPoint.Position)
    if typeof(landingPoint) == "Vector3" then
        return landingPoint
    end

    return spawnPoint.Position
end

local function spawnKingMoose(nest: Model)
    if not GameHelper.Switch.KingMoose then return end
    if not nest or not nest:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

    if kingMooseState.nest and kingMooseState.nest ~= nest then return end
    kingMooseState.nest = nest

    if kingMooseState.isSpawning then return end
    if workspace.DistributedGameTime < kingMooseState.nextSpawnTime then return end
    if #CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.KingMoose) > 0 then return end

    local spawnPosition = getKingMooseSpawnPosition(nest)
    if typeof(spawnPosition) ~= "Vector3" then return end

    kingMooseState.isSpawning = true

    local boss:Model? = nil
    local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
        boss = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(116)
        if not boss then
            error("Missing enemy prefab/config for id 116")
        end

        boss:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spawnPosition) + SPAWN_HEIGHT_OFFSET)
        boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.KingMoose)
        boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss)

        local humanoid = boss:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then
            error("King Moose prefab is missing a Humanoid")
        end

        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            kingMooseState.nextSpawnTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + RESPAWN_COOLDOWN
            local respawnNest = kingMooseState.nest
            task.delay(RESPAWN_COOLDOWN,function()
                if kingMooseState.nest ~= respawnNest then return end
                if not respawnNest or not respawnNest:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
                spawnKingMoose(respawnNest)
            end)
        end)

        boss.Parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(116)
    end)

    kingMooseState.isSpawning = false

    if not success then
        if boss then
            boss:Destroy()
        end
        warn(string.format("[AnimalBossSpawnService] Failed to spawn KingMoose: %s",tostring(errorMessage)))
    end
end

local function onKingMooseNestAdded(nest: Instance)
    if not nest:IsA("Model") then return end
    if kingMooseState.nest and kingMooseState.nest ~= nest then return end
    spawnKingMoose(nest)
end

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.KingMooseNest):Connect(onKingMooseNestAdded)
for _,nest in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.KingMooseNest)) do
    task.defer(onKingMooseNestAdded,nest)
end
"},{"id":354,"text":"local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameEnum = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))

local feedbackEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("RangedHitFeedbackS2C")
local featureSwitch = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版移动端射击视角")

local AGGREGATION_WINDOW_SECONDS = 0.05
local RECORD_TTL_SECONDS = 6
local MAX_RECORDS_PER_PLAYER = 64
local MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991

local FEEDBACK_HEADSHOT = 1
local FEEDBACK_KILL = 2

type FeedbackRecord = {
    lastTouchedAt: number,
    sentLevel: number,
    pendingLevel: number,
    sawHeadshot: boolean,
    sawKill: boolean,
    flushScheduled: boolean,
}

type PlayerRecords = {
    records: {[number]: FeedbackRecord},
    count: number,
}

local recordsByPlayer: {[Player]: PlayerRecords} = {}

local function isValidShotToken(value): boolean
    return type(value) == "number"
        and value == value
        and value > 0
        and value <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
        and value % 1 == 0
end

local function getFeedbackLevel(isHeadshot: boolean, isKill: boolean): number
    if isKill then
        return FEEDBACK_KILL
    end
    if isHeadshot then
        return FEEDBACK_HEADSHOT
    end
    return 0
end

local function pruneExpiredRecords(playerRecords: PlayerRecords, now: number)
    for shotToken, record in pairs(playerRecords.records) do
        if now - record.lastTouchedAt >= RECORD_TTL_SECONDS then
            playerRecords.records[shotToken] = nil
            playerRecords.count -= 1
        end
    end
end

local function evictOldestRecord(playerRecords: PlayerRecords)
    local oldestToken = nil
    local oldestTouchedAt = math.huge

    for shotToken, record in pairs(playerRecords.records) do
        if record.lastTouchedAt < oldestTouchedAt then
            oldestToken = shotToken
            oldestTouchedAt = record.lastTouchedAt
        end
    end

    if oldestToken ~= nil then
        playerRecords.records[oldestToken] = nil
        playerRecords.count -= 1
    end
end

local function getOrCreateRecord(player: Player, shotToken: number, now: number): (PlayerRecords, FeedbackRecord)
    local playerRecords = recordsByPlayer[player]
    if not playerRecords then
        playerRecords = {
            records = {},
            count = 0,
        }
        recordsByPlayer[player] = playerRecords
    end

    pruneExpiredRecords(playerRecords, now)

    local record = playerRecords.records[shotToken]
    if record then
        record.lastTouchedAt = now
        return playerRecords, record
    end

    while playerRecords.count >= MAX_RECORDS_PER_PLAYER do
        evictOldestRecord(playerRecords)
    end

    record = {
        lastTouchedAt = now,
        sentLevel = 0,
        pendingLevel = 0,
        sawHeadshot = false,
        sawKill = false,
        flushScheduled = false,
    }
    playerRecords.records[shotToken] = record
    playerRecords.count += 1
    return playerRecords, record
end

local function scheduleFeedback(player: Player, shotToken: number, record: FeedbackRecord)
    if record.flushScheduled then
        return
    end

    record.flushScheduled = true
    task.delay(AGGREGATION_WINDOW_SECONDS, function()
        local playerRecords = recordsByPlayer[player]
        if not playerRecords or playerRecords.records[shotToken] ~= record then
            return
        end

        record.flushScheduled = false
        if featureSwitch.Value ~= true or player.Parent ~= Players then
            return
        end

        local feedbackLevel = record.pendingLevel
        record.pendingLevel = 0
        if feedbackLevel <= record.sentLevel then
            return
        end

        record.sentLevel = feedbackLevel
        feedbackEvent:FireClient(player, {
            ShotToken = shotToken,
            IsHeadshot = record.sawHeadshot,
            IsKill = record.sawKill,
        })
    end)
end

GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(attacker, npc, _damage, _damageSource, context)
    if featureSwitch.Value ~= true then return end
    if typeof(attacker) ~= "Instance" or not attacker:IsA("Player") or attacker.Parent ~= Players then return end
    if typeof(npc) ~= "Instance" or not npc:IsA("Model") or not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then return end
    if type(context) ~= "table" or context.RangedWeapon ~= true then return end
    if not isValidShotToken(context.ShotToken) then return end

    -- onNpcTakeDamage only fires after NPCTakeDamage accepts and applies damage.
    -- Reading life state here therefore distinguishes an authoritative kill from a predicted hit.
    local isKill = not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc)
    local isHeadshot = context.IsCritical == true
    local feedbackLevel = getFeedbackLevel(isHeadshot, isKill)
    if feedbackLevel == 0 then return end
    local shotToken = context.ShotToken
    local _, record = getOrCreateRecord(attacker, shotToken, os.clock())

    record.sawHeadshot = record.sawHeadshot or isHeadshot
    record.sawKill = record.sawKill or isKill
    record.pendingLevel = math.max(record.pendingLevel, feedbackLevel)

    if record.pendingLevel > record.sentLevel then
        scheduleFeedback(attacker, shotToken, record)
    end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    recordsByPlayer[player] = nil
end)

featureSwitch:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
    if featureSwitch.Value ~= true then
        table.clear(recordsByPlayer)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(2)
        local now = os.clock()
        for player, playerRecords in pairs(recordsByPlayer) do
            if player.Parent ~= Players then
                recordsByPlayer[player] = nil
            else
                pruneExpiredRecords(playerRecords, now)
                if playerRecords.count == 0 then
                    recordsByPlayer[player] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
"},{"id":355,"text":"local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local CharacterValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CharacterValue
local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

function onTagAdded(tool:Tool,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return end
    tool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon)

    local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)

    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)

    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(bunny,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer)
    local v_walkSpeed:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(bunny,"walkSpeed")
    v_walkSpeed.Value = humanoid.WalkSpeed

    local walkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(bunny,136499501774711)
    local lastHurtTime:number = -1000
    local running:boolean = false
    local originWalkSpeed = v_walkSpeed.Value

    local setRunning = function(isRunning)
        if running == isRunning then return end
        running = isRunning
        if running then
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bunny,"walkSpeed","被揍了",10)
        else
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bunny,"walkSpeed","被揍了",0)
        end
    end

    local moveToRandomPoint = function(radius:number)
        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
			humanoid.Jump = true
		end
        local position = bunny:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(
            math.random(-radius, radius),
            0,
            math.random(-radius, radius)
        )
        humanoid:MoveTo(position)
    end

    local onMoveFinished = function()
        local isFear = lastHurtTime + 10 > workspace.DistributedGameTime
        setRunning(isFear)
        if isFear then
            -- 惊恐状态
            moveToRandomPoint(30)
        else
            -- 安逸状态
            -- task.wait( 1 + math.random() * 5)
            -- moveToRandomPoint(10)
            task.delay(1 + math.random() * 5,function()
                moveToRandomPoint(10)
            end)
            -- print("走")
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections,humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
        if speed > 0 and humanoid.Health > 0  then
            if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            walkTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / originWalkSpeed)
        else
            if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(onMoveFinished))
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
        if not bunny:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bunny) then return end

        if humanoid.Health > 0 then
            lastHurtTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            onMoveFinished()
        else
            local meatCount = math.random(1,2)
            for i=1,meatCount do
                local meat = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateRawMeat(bunny:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),2,math.random(-1,1)))
                if bunny:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCBurning) then
                    -- 着火状态下掉落熟肉
                    ResourcesItemHelper:Cooked(meat)
                end
            end
            if math.random(1,3) == 1 then
                local position = bunny:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),2,math.random(-1,1))
                local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(GameEnum.ResItemId.RabbitFoot)
                item:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
            end
            
            bunny:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ragdoll)
            bunny:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalDeath)
            bunny:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bunny)
        end
    end))

    -- moveToRandomPoint(10)
    onMoveFinished()
end

            if runTrack then
                if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
                if not runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Play() end
            else
                if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            end
        else
            if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Stop() end
        end

        if walkTrack and walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
        if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Stop() end

function findTargetPlayer()
    local deerPos = LowerPart.Position
    local retPlayer:Player
    local retCharacter:Model
    local lastDistance:number = 9999999
    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then continue end

        local humanoid:Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end

        local distance = (deerPos - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
        if not retCharacter or distance < lastDistance then
            retPlayer = player
            retCharacter = character
            lastDistance = distance
        end
    end
    return retPlayer
end

    else
        ControllerManager.MovingDirection = Vector3.zero
    end

    -- 需要先设置一下位置，不然会因为距离太远找不到目标，触发小鹿离开
    deer:PivotTo(RootPart.CFrame)

    local isHungry:boolean = v_state.Value == GameEnum.DeerState.Hungry
    local state = v_state.Value
    v_stunned.Value = false

    local moveTrack:AnimationTrack = walkTrack

            if not moveSound.Playing then moveSound:Play() end

            -- CommonFunc:StopMove(deer) -- 停止移动

            stunnedTrack:Stop()
            atkCD = 1
            v_stunned.Value = false

            if state == GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then
                -- 如果是偷看状态，直接离开
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
            end
        else

    if state == GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then

            checkCD -= dt
            autoLeaveCD -= dt

                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
                return

            if checkCD > 0 then return end
            checkCD = 2

            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(LowerPart.Position,15,overlapParams)
            for _,hitPart:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                local character:Model = CommonFunc:GetModel(hitPart)
                if not character then continue end
                if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then continue end

                -- 直接走了
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
                return
            end
        end))
    else
        local attackTracks:{AnimationTrack} = {}
        for i,animId in ipairs(attackAnimIds) do
            local attackTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(deer,animId)
            attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            attackTrack.Looped = false
            attackTrack:Stop()
            table.insert(attackTracks,attackTrack)
        end

        -- 攻击检测
        local atkTimes = 0
        table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
            atkCD -= dt
            if atkCD > 0 then return end
            if v_stunned.Value then return end
            if deer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DeerLeave) then return end
            -- atkCD = 1

            local player:Player = v_targetPlayer.Value
            if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

            local character = player.Character
            local distance = (LowerPart.Position - character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(TouchPart.CFrame,TouchPart.Size,overlapParams)
            if #hits > 0 then
                -- 检测障碍
                local isObs = CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(deer,character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment)
                if isObs then return end

                playAttackUIEffect(player)
                GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,damage)
                local human:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if human.Health <= 0 then
                    v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
                    GameHelper.KilledByBossS2C:FireClient(player,robot)
                end

                atkCD = ATK_CD
                moveToCD = ATK_CD
                findTargetCD = 1
                -- CommonFunc:StopMove(deer) -- 停止移动
                moveTo()
                -- 播放攻击动画
                atkTimes += 1
                local index = atkTimes % #attackTracks + 1
                local atkTrack = attackTracks[index]
                atkTrack:Play()
                atkSound:Play()
                if index == 1 then
                    atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
                end
            elseif distance > 300 then
                -- 距离玩家太远了，离开
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
            end
        end))

        -- 移动检测
        table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
            findTargetCD -= dt
            moveToCD -= dt
            if v_stunned.Value then return end
            -- local range = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 10 -- 10是为了避免小鹿在营火范围内时，仍然会被追逐
            if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
                if moveToCD <= 0 then
                    local character = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
                    -- humanoid:MoveTo(character:GetPivot().Position)
                    moveTo(character:GetPivot().Position)
                end
            else
                if findTargetCD <= 0 then
                    findTargetCD = 3
                    v_targetPlayer.Value = findTargetPlayer()
                    if not v_targetPlayer.Value then
                        GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
    end

    -- 检测营火范围
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not v_targetPlayer.Value then return end
        if v_stunned.Value then return end
        if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(LowerPart.Position) then
            -- 如果小鹿在营火范围内，停止追逐，进入僵直
            v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
            findTargetCD = 99999
            moveToCD = 99999
            -- humanoid:MoveTo(deer:GetPivot().Position) -- 停止移动
            -- CommonFunc:StopMove(deer) -- 停止移动
            moveTo()
            -- print("播放小鹿僵直动画")
            GameHelper:DeerStunned()

            task.wait(2)
            -- 小鹿逃跑
            GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
        end
    end))
end
